# The Golden Record: Earth’s Contents and Playback Instructions

Both Voyager spacecraft carried a gold-plated record containing selected material from Earth. Its contents included 115 analog images, natural sounds, music from different cultures and eras, and spoken greetings in 55 languages.

Each record was accompanied by a cartridge and needle, along with symbolic instructions explaining the spacecraft’s origin and how to play the audio. The Golden Record thus paired a collection of material from Earth with guidance for playing it.
